text:
devon: hey @maria — hitting a reproducible UI freeze in the playground when typing. It locks for ~3-5s, then resumes. Happened on Chrome 120 (macOS Ventura) and Chrome on Win10. I grabbed one request id from the network panel: x-request-id: req_8f3b2a. Happened at ~2026-03-12 16:02 UTC. Can you share quick steps for getting HAR + console dumps? I can attach to the ticket.

maria: sorry you're seeing this. yes we need a HAR + console + the minimal repro steps. quick checklist below — follow exactly and attach to the support ticket:

maria: 1) reproduce in an incognito window (no extensions) or disable extensions. 2) Open Chrome DevTools -> Network. 3) Check "Preserve log" and the red record dot is active. 4) Also open Console tab -> right-click -> "Save as..." to export console logs (or use Copy -> All). 5) Reproduce the issue (type the prompt until freeze). 6) In Network, right-click the request(s) that show long durations or errors and choose "Copy -> Copy as cURL" OR right-click the list and "Save all as HAR". 7) IMPORTANT: redact any Authorization headers before uploading. 8) Rename files like: har_playground_chrome_mac_1767777000.har and console_playground_chrome_mac_1767777000.txt and attach.

maria: sample curl to paste (redact token):

```
# example — paste after you copy-as-curl then remove sensitive headers
curl 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat' \
  -H 'authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -H 'x-request-id: req_8f3b2a' \
  --data-raw '{"input":"hello"}' \
  --compressed
```

maria: If you can't save console: take a screenshot of Console showing errors + copy the last 50 lines and paste into a .txt.

maria: Also include: OS/browser + exact browser version, approximate local time when it happened, steps to reproduce (e.g., paste a 3‑line sequence), whether it's repeatable in incognito, and whether you have any proxy/VPN.

devon: got it — will capture and upload to ticket #12345. do you want the full HAR or minimal (only failing requests)?

maria: full HAR please. it helps us see all timings (DNS, SSL, TTFB). if it's large, you can gzip it.

kai: from eng side — if you can get the x-request-id header we can correlate with backend logs. also paste the network waterfall screenshot if possible. :mag:

support-bot: reminder: upload link: https://support.redwood.ai/upload — max 200MB. Please mark ticket as "UI: typing freeze" and set priority P2.

devon: upload complete, files attached (har + console txt) and added the curl. thanks!

maria: perfect — thanks. we will triage and follow up with logs we pull using x-request-id. :thumbsup:
